evidence.source: Ministry of Education, R.O.C., Dictionary of Chinese Character Variants
evidence.field: 站 entry, structure, pronunciation and cited senses
evidence.text: The entry says 站 is absent from Shuowen and describes its visible structure as left 立 and right 占. It gives Mandarin zhàn and records standing senses and the travel-stop/transfer-station sense, citing 元史 for 站赤. It also links to reproductions of entries in 龍龕手鏡, 龍龕手鑑, 廣韻, 集韻, and other dictionaries. This supports the reported structure and lexicographic witnesses, but does not show a sequence of changing forms or date the first spoken use.
evidence.title: [A02978] 站 - Ministry of Education 《Dictionary of Chinese Character Varients》2024

evidence.field: File description, source attribution, and license for 立-seal.svg
evidence.text: The page identifies the file as a modern vector drawing of 立 in Shuowen seal-script style and names sources consulted for the ancient character, including the Sinica database and hanziyuan. It links the particular drawing to hanziyuan entry image s07554 and states that the SVG representation is public domain. It illustrates the 立 component only, not a historical specimen of 站.

evidence.field: File description and source project information for 占-script image candidates
evidence.text: Search results surfaced Commons records for 占-oracle.svg and 占-silk.svg, describing modern vector depictions of 占 in oracle-bone and silk-script styles. The Commons project page explains its script categories and says its illustrations are freely usable, but the exact 占-seal.svg page and original-file link could not be inspected in this run. No 占 candidate is selected on search-result evidence alone.

search_audit.query: 站 character 立 占 phonetic Guangyun 元史 字源; site:commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File: 占-seal.svg; site:commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File: 立-seal.svg; 站 historical glyph Xiaoxuetang 站 字形演变
search_audit.outcome: Inspected the MOE character entry and the exact Commons page for 立-seal.svg. The exact 占-seal.svg page returned a cache miss. Search results also surfaced 占 candidate files but did not provide enough inspected description-page evidence to select them.

search_audit.query: "占-seal.svg" Wikimedia Commons; site:upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons 占-seal.svg; 站 glyph historical image Wikimedia Commons character
search_audit.outcome: Search results surfaced 占-oracle.svg and 占-silk.svg; direct opens for the exact 占-oracle and 占-seal description pages returned cache misses. Opened the Commons project page, which describes its image categories and reuse statement. No 站 historical specimen was established.

gaps: No historical glyph sequence for 站 was found in the inspected material. The reported 立+占 structure does not establish the character's graphic evolution or any corruption hypothesis.
Although the MOE page cites medieval dictionaries and a 元史 passage, the exact earliest dated witness for the standing sense and the history connecting standing with station remain unresolved.
No selected image depicts 站 itself. The reusable 立-seal.svg is explicitly only a component drawing; the exact 占 file page could not be inspected to verify its direct image URL and rights.

items.period: Shuowen seal-script style (modern vector rendering; not a dated artifact image)
items.caption: 立 in Shuowen seal-script style, shown as the meaning-bearing component reported in 站.
items.alt: Black vector outline of 立 in a seal-script style on a plain background.
items.selection_reason: The MOE dictionary identifies 立 as the left-hand component of 站. The Commons description identifies this exact file as 立 in Shuowen seal-script style and links its drawing to a named hanziyuan image. It can illustrate the component but cannot document 站's historical form.
items.rights: Public domain per the exact Commons file description page; page attributes the underlying character image source to Richard Sears/hanziyuan and the SVG drawing to file contributors.

limitations.text: This candidate is a modern vector drawing of a component, not an ancient artifact photograph or a historical form of 站. No exact, reusable 站 glyph specimen was verified.
